meta.title: A vendor cannot open an event they were not invited to
gaps: what the screen shows (an API plan checks the data, not the page)
warnings: act 1: QA vendor 2 is not invited in this setup — it acts as an uninvited vendor

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: A second QA vendor sends the request that reads the round, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “You are not allowed to view this event.”, and never with a server error.
